items.title: Samsung Electronics To Establish HVAC Production Line in Korea
items.what_happened: Samsung Electronics today announced that it will establish a FläktGroup HVAC production line in Korea to target the rapidly growing HVAC market, including the production of advanced cooling solutions for AI data centers.
